metadata.description: Triqual: a methodology for working with Claude Code

plugins.name: progress-tracking
plugins.description: Strict progress tracking: one entry per task, the overall status and per-plan task ledgers driven by triqual tasks, kept up to date by gates that enforce them and a hook that injects the state at every session start. Committed mode (progress.md and status.md in the repo), local mode (under .git) or store mode (a local database, nothing in the repo or its history).

plugins.name: workflow-gate
plugins.description: Caps the agents a Workflow script launches per model: fable 3, opus 8, sonnet 12, haiku unlimited

plugins.name: roles
plugins.description: Eight role agents for plan execution, from brief writing and candidate hunting to the final adversarial review

plugins.name: methodology
plugins.description: Methodology core: triqual's own orchestrator, workflow skills that dispatch the roles agents and drive progress tracking (task ledger), global rules, triqual sync and doctor, drift notices; installs the other plugins

plugins.name: memory-report
plugins.description: Optional weekly local report on the health of the claude-mem memory (hygiene, storage and growth, Chroma health) plus LLM insights on proposed rules, skill changes and stale notes from allowlisted personal projects. Runs lazily from a SessionStart hook and shows one line until the report is read.

plugins.name: headjack
plugins.description: Optional. A personal vault for agent skills: import the skills you already have, then search and install them only when a task needs them. Local mode runs on SQLite with no server (Node 22.16 or newer).
